decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension shall not be adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a single storey conservatory extension to rear of the house, by reason of its positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, are considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, and the immediate local area. The proposal would not be harmful to the amenities of any neighbouring properties, including the immediately attached neighbouring property.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), and ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003), and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2002 and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of single storey conservatory extension to rear of house
